rule: <profile>.<area>.<rule>, profile in planner|tester|coder|reviewer|coach|shared; file conventions/<profile>/<area>/<id>.convention.yaml under each source root

atdd-bun.profiles.presets.reason: the agent proposes which profile presets to activate, whichever profile is running; shared (could be coach)

atdd-bun.topology.e2e-location.reason: e2e route/journey test paths are tester-authored files

atdd-bun.topology.feature-source-coverag.reason: cross-artifact closure from plan DESIRED OUTCOMES to source; shared (could be coder)

atdd-bun.topology.feature-test-coverage.reason: a feature with DESIRED OUTCOMES has a bound test: tester obligation (could be a shared closure)

atdd-bun.topology.plan-location.reason: plan paths are written by the planner but read by every profile and validator; shared (could be planner)

atdd-bun.topology.source-location.reason: source path + component URN: the coder writes it, the tester binds to it; shared (could be coder)

atdd-bun.topology.test-location.reason: test path, test URN and acceptance binding are tester-authored files

atdd-flow.collaboration.reason: Flow policy has a 2-segment id; the rule segment is taken from its name ('durable accountable delegation')

traceability.plan.executable-acceptance-.reason: acceptance -> test binding; the profile design gives traceability.* to the Tester

traceability.source.tested-by-present.reason: owner decision 2026-11-19: shared, because the coder writes the source witness header and the tester owns closure

traceability.source.tested-by-resolves.reason: owner decision 2026-11-19: shared, same split as tested-by-present

traceability.test.binding-resolves.reason: a test names a resolvable acceptance/DESIRED_OUTCOME/user-system-flow; tester-authored

vocabulary.note: old names resolve through these maps; detector names are kept for traceability to the upstream atdd-bun detectors
